# Cypress API Tester Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > Cypress

## Overview

Tests REST APIs with Cypress using cy.request for integration testing with proper assertion patterns and authentication handling

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [cypress-api-tester-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
cypress-api-tester-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@cypress-api-tester` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Test API endpoints with cy.request
- Implement authentication token handling
- Validate response schemas with JSON schema
- Chain API calls for workflow testing

## Technology Standards Applied

- **cy.request**: Cypress HTTP request patterns
- **API Testing**: REST API test design best practices
- **Schema Validation**: Response schema verification patterns
